base: One shared dataset with table, board, calendar, gallery and form views. Typed fields, filters, sorting, record details and Excel export.
table: A collaborative spreadsheet with typed columns, multi-cell copy and paste, fill down, sorting, filtering, search, and Excel or CSV export.
doc: Write together with headings, lists, tasks, tables and code blocks. Each paragraph saves independently. Export Markdown or a web page.
slides: Create presentations with covers, key points, charts, cards, tables and quotes. Edit on the slide, reorder, present full screen and export editable PowerPoint.
meeting: Record your microphone and meeting audio separately, transcribe locally and identify speakers. Edit, search, replay and export transcripts; ask an agent for summaries, decisions and action items.
code: A VS Code-style editor with a file tree, tabs, syntax highlighting, find and replace, multiple cursors and a minimap. Preview HTML or Markdown and download the project as a ZIP.
issues: Track issues and projects with IDs, statuses, priorities, assignees and labels. Use list or board views and keyboard commands; assign work to agents and see their updates.
devtools: JSON, Base64, URL encoding, hashes, timestamps, UUIDs, JWT inspection, regex, text diff, naming, number bases and colors. Everything runs locally; saved tools are shared.
todo: A shared list with due dates, assignees, notes, importance and drag ordering. Add tasks with Enter or ask an agent to organize your action items.
notes: Nested pages with rich text, icons, covers, favorites, search and trash. Write with slash commands, organize your ideas and work with agents on shared pages.
disk: Explore disk and folder usage, find large files and move selected items to Trash. Scans run on this computer; files can be restored until Trash is emptied.
stocks: Follow A-shares, Hong Kong and US stocks in one workspace. Share watchlists and notes, inspect candlesticks, volume and moving averages, and switch market data providers or use your own gateway.
proxy-console: Manage an existing local Mihomo or sing-box core: traffic, policies, node delay, connections and configuration summaries. Credentials stay local. Requires Clash API and a desktop App with proxy controller support.
ledger: Track income, expenses, balance and monthly budgets together. Review categories and daily entries, or ask an agent to organize your bills.
habit: Build habits together. Check in each day, follow weekly progress and streaks, and see how family or teammates are doing.
design-studio: Create websites, app interfaces, posters, presentations, social images and dashboards. Edit canvases and layers, preview HTML, collect feedback, save versions and export SVG, PNG or HTML with your agents.
whiteboard: An infinite canvas for sticky notes, text, shapes and connectors. Drag, zoom and color your ideas; work with agents on brainstorms, retrospectives and flows.
mindmap: Organize ideas as topics and branches. Edit, fold, reorder and drag topics, collaborate with agents, and export an outline or image.
video: Import video, split and trim clips, change speed, add text and mask faces or number plates. Export MP4 locally. Media stays on this computer; the edit plan is shared with people and agents.
motion: Make product promos, data stories and vertical shorts with motion: start from a template and change the words, pictures and colours, or ask an agent to write every scene (HTML with animation). Leave notes on moments for the agent, or have it remake a reference video; add music and voice, cut on the beat, turn speech into captions, save templates for everyone, and export an MP4 on this computer.
photo: Crop, adjust colors, filter, retouch, add text or stickers, draw, mask and frame your photos. Originals stay local; share edit instructions and undo any change.
gomoku: Play five-in-a-row with another person or an agent. Choose black or white, take turns, undo moves, resign or start a new round.
sudoku: Solve a puzzle together. Each cell saves separately with the player's color, conflicts are highlighted, and easy, medium or hard puzzles have one solution.
remote-desktop: View and control your Mac and Windows computers. Optional component, view-only mode, temporary pairing codes and instant disconnect. LAN or Tailscale; audio, lock screens and public relay are not included yet.
recorder: Record your screen, trim and split clips, add text and focus zooms, then export MP4 locally. Footage stays on your computer; agents can help with the edit.
cinema: Watch movies and series from your own sources. Search catalogs, choose episodes, share a watchlist and resume locally, with playback speed and intro/outro skipping. No sources are bundled.
